proof_text:
unfold myMin myMin_postcond
  have h_main : ((myMin a b h_precond ≤ a ∧ myMin a b h_precond ≤ b) ∧ (myMin a b h_precond = a ∨ myMin a b h_precond = b)) := by
    dsimp only [myMin, myMin_postcond]
    split_ifs with h
    · -- Case: a ≤ b
      constructor
      · -- Prove that a is the minimum and a ≤ b
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · -- Prove that a = a (true by reflexivity)
        exact Or.inl rfl
    · -- Case: b < a
      constructor
      · -- Prove that b is the minimum and b ≤ a
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · -- Prove that b = b (true by reflexivity)
        exact Or.inr rfl
  exact h_main
